explication: This repository is a collection of setup guides and shell launchers for Linux desktops on Android through Termux. The documented user journey is to choose native Termux, PRoot, or chroot; follow the corresponding installation instructions; then use a desktop launcher with Termux X11 (and audio). README documents these capabilities, but no source excerpts were supplied, so the graph does not assert internal calls between scripts or infer launcher behavior beyond their names and locations.
